target_customer: Pharma and biotech partners and eventually patients with autoimmune disease
problem: Autoimmune drugs are limited; parasites evolved proteins that calm human immune responses, but mining them at scale is hard.
business_model: Drug discovery and therapeutic development with likely pharma partnerships; no revenue stated
product_category: AI enabled biotherapeutics from parasite derived proteins

founders.name: Dennis Sun
education: UC Berkeley, PhD evolutionary and developmental biology
founders.background_notes: A search profile names Arcadia Science, 2022 to 2025, as the biotech; not from an opened source.

founders.name: Adair Borges
education: UCSF, PhD parasitology, virology and genomics
founders.background_notes: Over 50 papers and coinventor on an anti-CRISPR protein patent, per the YC page; led a venture creation team at an early stage biotech.

founders.name: Emily Weiss
education: PhD microbiology, genomics and plant genetics (institution not named)
founders.background_notes: Leads the platform for engineering parasite derived therapeutics; published in Nature Microbiology and eLife.

competitors.name: Helmedix
competitors.what: Synthetic versions of parasite secreted molecules as peptide drugs

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs protein language models, engineering of therapeutics and biology validation; the company reports 1 to 2 nM binding in early experiments.

defensibility.rationale: Corpus, biobank of immune memory and possible patents could compound; no patents or programs are named.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found as of 2026-11; few companies pursue parasite protein mining.

market_need_then: Autoimmune disease is a large market with limited cures, and helminth therapy showed some efficacy but is impractical, motivating molecule based approaches.

branding.domain_note: dittobio.com, a prefix style variant; brand searches return unrelated Ditto companies.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and science driven with provocative lines like We're mining an untapped source of natural drugs: parasites

branding.brand_signature: The parasite mining story and the line The best drugs come from nature
branding.community_and_virality: Featured by the Decoding Bio newsletter and Huge Magazine in March 2026

brand_strength.rationale: A friendly but common word crowded by other Ditto brands; the parasite narrative is the memorable asset.

outcome_analysis: Ditto is an active Winter 2026 biotech with deeply credentialed founders who worked together for three years at a prior startup, per the YC launch post. No verified funding or programs are public. The idea is novel but drug development takes years and capital, so progress depends on proving candidates and raising follow on funding.
notes: Funding unverified: Caplight and Standout list a $500K seed or pre seed (dates January to March 2026) and Preqin mentions Pioneer Fund; all aggregator pages seen in snippets only, so not recorded as rounds. The YC launch post mentions no funding. Company is described as founded 2025 by the YC page. Founders' Arcadia Science link is from an unopened profile. Paragen Bio (Australian parasitic worm therapeutics, about $6M per an undated SmartCompany headline) omitted from competitors because no date was found.
